results.title: Top 50 Cal Sports Moments – No. 17: Stadium Debut, 1923
results.snippet: THE MOMENT: In the early afternoon of Saturday, November 24, 1923, the kickoff of the 29th Big Game between Cal and Stanford marked the official opening of Memorial Stadium, which remains Cal’s home football venue today. More than 73,000 people jammed into the stadium that had an official capacity of 72,609 to be present at “The House that Andy Built” to see the powerhouse Golden Bears beat a strong Stanford team 9-0 and finish unbeaten.
